lead.t: Hereditary elliptocytosis, hereditary pyropoikilocytosis, and related disorders are characterized by the finding of elliptocytes on peripheral blood smear.

Hereditary Elliptocytosis, Hereditary Pyropoikilocytosis, and RelatedDisorders

qs.q: What morphological appearance on a peripheral blood smear is characteristic of hereditary pyropoikilocytosis?
qs.e: Hereditary pyropoikilocytosis is a subtype of hereditary elliptocytosis characterized by severe hemolytic anemia with findings on peripheral blood smear reminiscent of a thermal burn. Both conditions involve overlapping mutations in spectrin.
